verdict.rationale: Onboarding speed is a fair question for a business banking platform, but the evidence never says how long it takes a founder to open and fully set up a Wise Business account. The docs cover account availability in 160+ countries, payments, cards and APIs, with no onboarding timeline, verification turnaround or setup process. The community items describe post-onboarding account changes and a compliance block, not how fast onboarding is, so they do not establish delivery either way.
